app.name: Esta
app.heroAlt: Hanoi rooftops looking towards the Long Bien bridge

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.emailIntro: Enter your email. Esta will send you a 6-digit code.
signIn.invalidEmail: That email does not look right. Check it and try again.
signIn.sendFailed: The code was not sent. Check your connection and try again.
signIn.codeSent: Esta sent a code to {email}. Look for the email titled “Mã đăng nhập Esta”. The code works for one hour. If you cannot find it, check your spam folder.
signIn.wrongCode: The code is wrong or has expired. Send a new code.
signIn.missingCode: Enter the 6-digit code from the email.
signIn.resendIn: Send a new code in {seconds} seconds
signIn.googleFailed: Google sign-in did not work. Try again or use an email code.
signIn.rateLimited: Esta sent several codes in the last hour. Use the newest code in your email, or wait a few minutes and try again.

onboarding.title: Create your household
onboarding.intro: Name the household and tell us your name. You will be its admin.
onboarding.displayNameHint: Others in the household see this name.
onboarding.tooLong: The name is longer than 120 characters. Shorten it and try again.
onboarding.createFailed: The household was not created. Check your connection and try again.
onboarding.inviteIntro: The person you invite signs in with this exact email and goes straight to {household}. Esta does not send an invite email yet, so let them know.

roleHints.viewer: Sees everything but cannot edit or invite.

onboarding.invalidEmail: That email does not look right. Check it and try again.
onboarding.alreadyInvited: This email is already invited or a member.
onboarding.inviteFailed: The invite was not saved. Check your connection and try again.
onboarding.invitedElsewhere: If someone invited you to a household, sign out and sign in with the exact email they invited.

home.later: Overview will show what has been collected this month, who has not paid yet and what needs doing today.

reasons.fractional: Đồng have no fractions. Drop the decimal part and try again.
reasons.too_large: This is more than Esta can record.
reasons.ambiguous_separators: Use dots to group thousands, for example 1.500.000.
reasons.ambiguous_shorthand: Write 3tr5 or 3,5tr, not both at once.

reasons.impossible: This day is not on the calendar.

status.overdue: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} overdue

completeness.missing: {count, plural, =0 {Complete} one {# item missing} other {# items missing}}

devVietqr.title: VietQR
devVietqr.intro: The sample invoice QR, read back from its image, and the S4 vectors. This page exists only in development.
devVietqr.splitNote: From {cap} the QR carries no amount; the payer splits the transfer.

sections.collections: Collections will show which rooms have paid this month and which have not, and record a payment in a few taps.
sections.documents: Documents will keep certificates, leases and ID cards in one place, found at once with one search box.
sections.assistant: The assistant will leave a note every morning about late rent, leases ending soon and missing papers.
sections.reports: Reports will hold the rental tax card and each property’s income and costs by year.
sections.settings: Display settings follow your account. The household, members and receiving bank accounts arrive here in the next update.
